GU_ZHEN_REN_EVENT_DAO_TIAN_ZHEN_CHUAN.pa: You stop in front of a secret inheritance. The two paths of inheritance lead to different opportunities, but both require you to pay a price first.
Lose {HpLoss} points HP. Go to Middle-earth.
Lose {HpLoss} points HP. Head to Kitahara.
The inheritance of Middle-earth is right in front of you. You can get Divine Concealment, or you can give up the real token in exchange for some money.
The true story of Kitahara is waiting for you. You can get Ghostly Concealment; if there is Uproot Mountain or Myriad Self Giant Hand in deck, you can also get Luo Po Valley.
You left the land of inheritance.

GU_ZHEN_REN_EVENT_BAI_GU_CHUAN_CHENG.pag: You step into a mountain range covered entirely with snow. With the memory of your past life, you found the entrance to White Bone Inheritance.
In the center of the first hall is a large vat of bones, with a large number of Gu worm sleeping in the vat. You can loot once or move on.
You took a Gu worm from the vat of bones. There is a strange noise coming from the passage behind you, and you must move on.
In the second hall, there are three white bone pillars erected, with a Gu worm held at the top of each pillar. You can take them separately.
In the third hall sat the remains of the talented scholar with gray bones. You can take his Vital Gu or move on.
Go to the Meat Sac Secret Pavilion.
You took away the Gray Bones Talent’s Vital Gu. The shouts of the pursuers could be heard clearly.
At the end of the inheritance is a meat bag secret pavilion. Countless mouths on the flesh wall store various Gu worms.
Get a random Bone Path reward.
Leave the Meat Sac Secret Pavilion.
You took the reward from the Meatbag Secret Chamber. The pursuers from the rear were approaching.
You didn't stop on the way, you found the hidden dark room of White Bone Inheritance outside Will, and obtained Battle Bone Wheel Gu and Killer MoveGu recipeWhite Bone Chariot.
You run all the way to the inheritance exit, only to find that the pursuers have Blocked the way. You can only choose one way to escape.
Suffered damage from {JumpDamage} points but unable to Block.
Suffered {FlightDamage} points but could not Block damage and escaped.
You rushed out of the siege with wounds.
You jumped off the cliff, paid the price and escaped from White Bone Inheritance.
You drove Footless Bird into the sky and escaped from White Bone Inheritance.

GU_ZHEN_REN_EVENT_NI_LIU_HE_EVENT.title: Reverse Flow River
Wow——! The raging tide sweeps you into a wide river. You recognize that this is Reverse Flow River. Gu worm cannot be activated here. You can only move forward with your own Strength.
Give up and leave Reverse Flow River.
You move on in Reverse Flow River. Progress: {Progress}/{MaxProgress}. Going forward will lose {HpLoss} points HP.
Lose {HpLoss} points HP and continue to swim against the current.
A seriously injured Gu Immortal floats down the current in front of you. He has lost the ability to resist.
A hostile Gu Immortal Blocked the way. Gu worm cannot be activated in Reverse Flow River, you can only fight with fists and feet.
A Rank 8 Gu Immortal Blocked the way. Although he cannot activate Gu worm, his body and experience are still extremely powerful.
A large and colorful tiger lies on a piece of driftwood. Driftwood might give you a break.
You find a Gu worm floating in the water. You can venture off course to scoop it up.
A Gu Immortal corpse floated down the river, and he seemed to be holding something in his hand.
A boulder like a hill was crashing down the river. You have to choose how to respond.
You are sucked into an underwater whirlpool. The undercurrent is tearing your body and belongings apart.
Obtain {RewardGoldMin}-{RewardGoldMax} Gold, and 25% of Chance will lose an additional HP.
Let go of what's going on and move on.
Have a physical fight with Rank 8 Gu Immortal.
Lose 3 points of HP and get a random Gu real person card.
Lose 3 points of HP and get a random Gu real person Relic.

You fight close to each other in the water. Current confrontation: {EncounterStep}/3.
Continue to fight with fists and kicks.
Continue to fight with Rank 8 Gu Immortal.
Give up the fight and leave Reverse Flow River.
You solve the immediate obstacle. You can move on or leave Reverse Flow River.
You persisted until the end of Reverse Flow River. The aura of Gu worm in your body reaches its extreme, and a white light condenses on you.
After Perseverance Gu is refined, the pressure on Reverse Flow River completely disappears. You gather the entire river into RelicReverse Flow River.
